ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Letting, Heads of terms and later stages need Heads of terms status and Headline rent (per year).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Letting", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Requirement qualified", 2, "Viewing", 3, "Offer", 4, "Heads of terms", 5, "Referencing", 6, "Legals", 7, "Completed", 8, 0) >= 5, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Heads_of_terms_status__c)), ISBLANK(Headline_rent__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Heads of terms status and Headline rent (per year) before moving to Heads of terms.
